subject: Fix top-level anyOf in MCP tool schemas (breaks headless claude -p)
description:
The MCP tools `subconscious_search_context` and `ask_subconscious` in lib/mcp-core.js each carry a top-level `anyOf: [{required:['intent']},{required:['situation']},{required:['query']}]` in their inputSchema (lines ~265 and ~312). The Anthropic API rejects top-level oneOf/allOf/anyOf in a custom tool's input_schema, so ANY headless `claude -p` invocation in this workspace fails with HTTP 400 `tools.N.custom.input_schema: input_schema does not support oneOf, allOf, or anyOf at the top level` before it can do work. Surfaced by the ARC-AGI-3 Mode 0 bench smoke run (both A/B arms returned the 400).

Fix: remove the top-level `anyOf` from BOTH inputSchemas, and re-enforce the same "at least one of intent/situation/query must be present" guard at runtime inside each tool's `run` handler (throw an Error with a clear message when none of intent/situation/query is a non-empty string). Thrown errors surface cleanly as isError tool results (lib/mcp-core.js:607). The downstream daemon already treats these fields as optional (lib/subconscious/index.js:527-528), so no daemon change is needed. Verify the smoke run no longer 400s: `python bench/arc_agi3_zonoid/runner.py --agent-command "claude -p" --task-ids arc-agi-3-smoke-1 --max-steps 5 --out-dir /tmp/arc-agi3-zonoid2`.
